svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 170 x 150 mm blank: the 150 x 130 mm top with a 10 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange on each edge. Drill a 3 mm relief hole at each corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold all four flanges 90 degrees down (drip edges).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 4.4 mm holes for the spacers: 35 mm each side and 28 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in front and behind a point 15 mm east of the top's middle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (the hood hangs 40 mm further over the west end, the lens end).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four 15 mm M4 aluminium spacers screw into the lid; the hood

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sits on them and four M4 screws hold it. The 15 mm air gap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: keeps sun and radiant heat off the box.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the flanges stand 5 mm or more clear of the lid all round.
